text_block_list.text: As I happened to walk past the cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do my best making sweets~♪
Let's have a great time today, both of you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes...♪
I'll do my absolute best as your cooking teacher.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I've got plenty of recipes~.
Let's bake some big, buono sweets~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Trainer-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Um, well, I wanted to bake some sweets
to thank you for everything, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I talked to the cafeteria lady, and she said, "Go right ahead and use it, dear!"♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If I bake a delicious cake,
Trainer-chan's heart will—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I-It's nothing at all!
Feel free to take a look, Trainer-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Then, add the granulated sugar and stir...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmm-hmm-hmm~♪

Though Mayano Top Gun is struggling with cooking,
something she isn't used to, she looks like she's having a lot of fun.

Though Mayano Top Gun is struggling with cooking,
something she isn't used to, she looks like she's having a lot of fun.

Watching her give it her all, words of
encouragement spilled naturally from my lips.
—And at the same time, my stomach let out a massive growl.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha♪
It'll be done in just a bit, so hang tight~

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I made some meringue cookies
in my spare time... Would you like one?
I gratefully ate the meringue cookies made by Nishino Flower and Hishi Akebono.
choice_data_list: Delicious! Just the way I like it!
Delicious! Just the way I like it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!?
Phew... I'm so glad it suits your taste.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Gaaahnn!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Maya was the one who wanted to be told
that it was delicious... that you loved the taste!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: (If it's come to this...!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Flower-chan, Buono-chan!
Maya will make the cake all by herself!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Are you okay~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No prob, no prob! Maya knows
Trainer-chan's tastes better than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(To surpass them, Maya has to
make an even more amazing dish all by herself!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: U-Uuuu~.

Mayano Top Gun's cake was finished,
but its shape and color were truly indescribable...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you'll love the taste!
I made it similar to Trainer-chan's favorite food!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya poured a whole lot of love into it, too...
Is it... not good enough?

Bracing myself, I took a bite of
Mayano Top Gun's cake, and—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Really!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Was it really delicious?!
Was it the flavor you like, Trainer-chan?!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay♪
We did it, we did it~~~~~!!
Having her cooking praised, Mayano Top Gun stayed in high spirits afterwards, happily breezing through her training.
When I told them that watching them cook made me want to make something myself—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, would you like to make it together if you want?
I can show you the steps...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, wait! Trainer-chan,
just watch Maya cook~!"
choice_data_list: I want to thank you too, Mayano.
I want to thank Mayano, too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: T-Trainie...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Eye copy☆
If that's the case, you're more than welcome♪"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Cooking together as friends~
That'll make the treats even more buono♪

I managed to finish the cake,
though it did end up a little burnt...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! Trainer-chan gave me
cake~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's a little bitter, but
this must be what grown-ups like♪"
choice_data_list: It's just burnt! You don't have to eat it!
It's just burnt! You really don't have to eat it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: No way!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Maya's gonna gobble up all of Trainer-chan's feelings without leaving a single bite!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So Trainer-chan, won't you have some of Maya's cake?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Say ahh♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~!
Did my feelings of gratitude reach you?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay~♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"F-From that close...
It makes even me nervous just watching!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's buono-buono,
so happily ever after~♪

With the help of her two friends, Mayano Top Gun's
sweets-making endeavor turned out to be a massive success.
